title: Spain publishes the statute of its AI supervision agency AESIA in the official gazette
summary: The publication in the BOE made Spain the first EU country with a dedicated AI supervision body, according to the page.
srcName: Wikipedia (es): Agencia Española de Supervisión de la Inteligencia Artificial

title: Abu Dhabi's Technology Innovation Institute releases Falcon 180B, a 180-billion-parameter language model, on Hugging Face
summary: The model was trained on 3.5 trillion tokens and allows commercial use under restrictive conditions.

title: US Senate holds its first bipartisan AI Insight Forum, convened by Majority Leader Schumer
summary: More than 60 senators, industry executives and civil rights leaders took part in a discussion of AI risks, safeguards and legislation.

title: Arm lists on Nasdaq, raising USD 4.87bn at a USD 54.5bn valuation
summary: SoftBank kept roughly 90% ownership of the chip designer after the year's largest IPO.

title: Seventeen authors with the Authors Guild file a class action against OpenAI, alleging use of their copyrighted work
summary: The suit alleges OpenAI's technology illegally used the authors' copyrighted books.

title: OpenAI releases DALL-E 3, a third version of its image generator, integrated into ChatGPT
summary: The Verge reports that OpenAI released the third version of DALL-E.

title: Writers Guild and studios reach a tentative agreement, and the resulting contract includes AI rules, Wikipedia says
summary: The deal ended the months-long dispute in which limits on AI in writing were among the writers' goals.
srcName: Wikipedia: 2023 Writers Guild of America strike

title: Amazon announces a partnership with Anthropic, investing USD 1.25bn toward a planned USD 4bn and taking a minority stake
summary: Wikipedia cites Reuters coverage dated 28 September of the Amazon investment.

title: French Competition Authority searches Nvidia's French offices in a probe of the graphics card sector, Wikipedia says
summary: The search was carried out under a judge-authorised investigation into suspected anti-competitive practices, and Nvidia had not commented.

title: ChatGPT can again access up-to-date information from the web, BBC reports
summary: OpenAI gave ChatGPT the ability to draw on current web content.

title: Meta announces AI-driven changes across its apps and devices
summary: Analytics Vidhya lists the announcement among September's Meta news.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline

title: Mistral AI releases Mistral 7B, a 7.3-billion-parameter model under the Apache 2.0 licence
summary: The company says the model outperforms Llama 2 13B on its benchmarks.

title: AWS makes Amazon Bedrock generally available
summary: Amazon Web Services opened its managed foundation-model service to all customers.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline
